market_reason: Tech/AI selloff and oil spiking to about $117 on fears of renewed US strikes on Iran, with a Treasury yield swing. These are elevated and worth watching, but they are not crisis-grade and are largely priced in.
market_headlines: Global Oil Price Hits $117 a Barrel, Highest Since April - The New York Times
Oil price rises above $117 a barrel amid fears US will renew strikes on Iran - The Guardian
S&P 500, Nasdaq end sharply lower as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff - Reuters
summary: An AI-driven tech selloff and an oil surge to multi-month highs on Middle East escalation risk dominate the news. This hurts the QLD, QQQ and XLK positions and helps XLE, USO and DBC. None of it is a fresh, specific, material event that justifies a veto.
